text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No. It's just... for some reason, all my 
senses feel strangely sharp...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, I feel like 
I've read a similar scene in a heroic tale 
before!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In the part where the hero hones themself 
to challenge the battle and claims an 
overwhelming victory—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not that I'm like that or anything, 
really! But, w-well...
